heroHeadline: Ukraine Strikes Novorossiysk, Damaging Four Russian Warships and Halting Black Sea Grain Exports
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,631, Ukraine's overnight assault on Russia's Novorossiysk naval base damaged four Black Sea Fleet warships — including the frigates Admiral Essen and Admiral Makarov — using jet-powered drones, Neptune cruise missiles, and naval drones, forcing two grain export terminals offline and killing at least two civilians; Zelensky called it proof Russia's 'last Black Sea sanctuary' is now within reach. The strike capped a punishing week: a Russian jet-powered Shahed drone killed two railway workers on an Odesa-region passenger train on Aug 13; North Korean KN-23 ballistic missiles killed 6-7 people at the Zaporizhstal steel plant and hit Kyiv's Nova Poshta logistics hub on Aug 11; and a Kharkiv high-rise strike killed two on Aug 9 amid a broader exchange that also struck Belgorod. Zelensky warned that Ukrainian intelligence shows Russia preparing a mass mobilization of hundreds of thousands after its September 20 Duma elections, as Russian military losses reached ~1,460,400 since 2022 (Ukrainian General Staff) — losses now outpacing recruitment. Diplomatically, the US Senate passed the Lindsey Graham Russia sanctions act 86–11, authorizing tariffs of up to 200% on buyers of Russian oil, though the bill still awaits House passage.
